candidates.change_summary: Changed the final return statement from returning true to returning false.
Replace the transferFrom amount argument `v` with `v + 1` so a different amount is transferred per recipient.
Replace the `from` owner argument with `msg.sender` so tokens are pulled from the caller instead of the given address.
Delete the `revert()` on failed external call so a failing transferFrom no longer reverts and the function returns true regardless.
Replace the transferFrom selector with that of `transfer(address,uint256)` so a different token function is invoked.
Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so successful calls return false instead of true.
Replace the transferred value v with 0 in the transferFrom call, so recipients receive 0 tokens instead of v.
Replace revert() with return false so a failed transferFrom causes the function to return false instead of reverting.
Delete the require(_tos.length > 0) check so an empty _tos array returns true instead of reverting.
Change the return statement from `return true;` to `return false;` so the function returns a different value.
Change the require to demand more than one destination so calls with exactly one recipient revert.
Remove the require so an empty recipient list no longer reverts and instead returns true.
Use the plain transfer(address,uint256) selector instead of transferFrom, changing which token function is called.
Start the loop at index 1, skipping the first recipient entirely.
Return false instead of true on success.
Send value v+1 in each transferFrom call instead of v.
Replace the return statement 'return true;' with 'return false;' so a completed call returns false instead of true.
Remove the require that the _tos array is non-empty, so an empty array now returns true instead of reverting.
Remove the failure check that reverts when the external transferFrom call fails, so the function returns true even if any call fails.
Replace the loop's transfer amount v with v + 1, so each external transferFrom call moves one more token than in the original.
Replace revert() with return false on a failed external call, so failures return false instead of reverting the transaction.
Change the return value from true to false so a successful call returns a different value.
Change the loop upper bound from _tos.length to _tos.length - 1 so the last recipient is skipped.
Transfer amount v is replaced by v - 1, sending one less unit to each recipient.
Delete the revert on failed transferFrom call so failures are silently ignored and the function still returns true.
Use _tos[0] as the recipient for every iteration instead of _tos[i], sending all amounts to a single recipient.
